title: Hasbro The Legend of Zelda Heroes of Hyrule Link | The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom Premium Collectible 6 Inch Action Figure
features: THE LEGEND OF ZELDA: TEARS OF THE KINGDOM: This officially licensed 6-inch-scale Link action figure is inspired by the action-adventure video game -- a great gift for collectors and fans ages 4 and up
PREMIUM DESIGN AND ARTICULATION: Fans can display this Legend of Zelda figure with game-inspired sculpt and design, 20+ articulation points, and a soft goods cape, in their collections
CHARACTER-INSPIRED ACCESSORIES: Pose out Link with the included Hylian shield, interchangeable Zonai power hand, and the Master Sword
WINDOW BOX PACKAGING: Display Legend of Zelda fandom on your shelf with window box packaging featuring game-inspired character art
BUILD OUT YOUR HEROES OF HYRULE COLLECTION: Look for more The Legend of Zelda action figures to build a sprawling kingdom of collectibles on your shelf (Each sold separately. Subject to availability)
UNCOVERING A MYSTERY: Link, the courageous hero of Hyrule, must gather the power of the Sages to aid him in his quest to defeat Ganondorf
